Name: ST-01 Config files present in config/ subfolder
Objective: Verify all limits config files are deployed in the correct location.
Test Script (Step): Navigate to the config/ subfolder in the project root.
Test Script (Expected Result): The config/ folder exists and is accessible.

Test Script (Step): Confirm BurnInLimits.yaml exists in config/.
Test Script (Expected Result): BurnInLimits.yaml is present and is a non-empty file.

Test Script (Step): Confirm CalLimits.yaml exists in config/.
Test Script (Expected Result): CalLimits.yaml is present and is a non-empty file.

Test Script (Step): Confirm BurnInLimGroups.yaml exists in config/.
Test Script (Expected Result): BurnInLimGroups.yaml is present and is a non-empty file.

Test Script (Step): Confirm CalLimGroups.yaml exists in config/.
Test Script (Expected Result): CalLimGroups.yaml is present and is a non-empty file.

Test Script (Step): Confirm StatisticsLimitsConfig.json exists in config/.
Test Script (Expected Result): StatisticsLimitsConfig.json is present and is a non-empty file.

Name: ST-02 BurnIn limits file loads without error
Objective: Verify BurnInLimits.yaml is valid YAML and loads on parse.
Test Script (Step): Launch the application.
Test Script (Expected Result): Application starts. Parse tab is visible. No crash.

Test Script (Step): Open the Parse tab and locate the BurnIn Limits path field.
Test Script (Expected Result): Parse tab is shown. BurnIn Limits path field is visible and empty.

Test Script (Step): Set the BurnIn Limits path field to config/BurnInLimits.yaml.
Test Script (Expected Result): Path field shows config/BurnInLimits.yaml.

Test Script (Step): Add at least one BurnIn _Protocol.txt file to the protocol list and click Parse Data.
Test Script (Expected Result): Parse operation starts; progress label updates.

Test Script (Step): Check the log / status area for errors after parsing completes.
Test Script (Expected Result): Status label reads 'Parsing finished. Protocols parsed: N.' No YAML parse error in the log. Application does not crash.

Name: ST-03 Cal limits file loads without error
Objective: Verify CalLimits.yaml is valid YAML and loads on parse.
Test Script (Step): Launch the application.
Test Script (Expected Result): Application starts. Parse tab is visible. No crash.

Test Script (Step): Open the Parse tab and locate the Cal Limits path field.
Test Script (Expected Result): Parse tab is shown. Cal Limits path field is visible and empty.

Test Script (Step): Set the Cal Limits path field to config/CalLimits.yaml.
Test Script (Expected Result): Path field shows config/CalLimits.yaml.

Test Script (Step): Add at least one Calibration _Protocol.txt file to the protocol list and click Parse Data.
Test Script (Expected Result): Parse operation starts; progress label updates.

Test Script (Step): Check the log / status area for errors after parsing completes.
Test Script (Expected Result): Status label reads 'Parsing finished. Protocols parsed: N.' No YAML parse error in the log. Application does not crash.

Name: ST-04 BurnIn groups combobox populated after Parse Data
Objective: Verify the BurnIn group combobox is filled from BurnInLimGroups.yaml after parsing.
Precondition: ST-02 passes. At least one BurnIn _Protocol.txt file is available.
Test Script (Step): Launch the application.
Test Script (Expected Result): Application starts without error.

Test Script (Step): Set the BurnIn Limits path to config/BurnInLimits.yaml and the BurnIn Groups path to config/BurnInLimGroups.yaml.
Test Script (Expected Result): Both path fields show the correct file paths.

Test Script (Step): Add at least one BurnIn _Protocol.txt file to the protocol list.
Test Script (Expected Result): The file appears in the selected protocols list.

Test Script (Step): Click Parse Data.
Test Script (Expected Result): Progress label shows 'Parsing finished. Protocols parsed: N.' No crash or error dialog.

Test Script (Step): Switch to the Statistics tab and inspect the BurnIn Groups combobox.
Test Script (Expected Result): BurnIn Groups combobox is enabled and contains one or more group names loaded from BurnInLimGroups.yaml.

Name: ST-05 Cal groups combobox populated after Parse Data
Objective: Verify the Cal group combobox is filled from CalLimGroups.yaml after parsing.
Precondition: ST-03 passes. At least one Calibration _Protocol.txt file is available.
Test Script (Step): Launch the application.
Test Script (Expected Result): Application starts without error.

Test Script (Step): Set the Cal Limits path to config/CalLimits.yaml and the Cal Groups path to config/CalLimGroups.yaml.
Test Script (Expected Result): Both path fields show the correct file paths.

Test Script (Step): Add at least one Calibration _Protocol.txt file to the protocol list.
Test Script (Expected Result): The file appears in the selected protocols list.

Test Script (Step): Click Parse Data.
Test Script (Expected Result): Progress label shows 'Parsing finished. Protocols parsed: N.' No crash or error dialog.

Test Script (Step): Switch to the Statistics tab and inspect the Cal Groups combobox.
Test Script (Expected Result): Cal Groups combobox is enabled and contains one or more group names loaded from CalLimGroups.yaml.

Name: ST-06 Parse Data with no protocol files - no crash
Objective: Verify the application handles an empty protocol list gracefully.
Test Script (Step): Open the Parse tab. Confirm the protocol list is empty.
Test Script (Expected Result): Protocol list is empty. No files shown.

Test Script (Step): Optionally set or leave blank the BurnIn / Cal limits paths.
Test Script (Expected Result): No error is raised when interacting with path fields.

Test Script (Step): Click Parse Data.
Test Script (Expected Result): Application does not crash. Status label immediately shows 'No protocols to be parsed.' and the function returns without parsing.

Name: ST-07 Parse Data with no limits paths - no crash
Objective: Verify parsing proceeds without crash when limits path fields are empty.
Precondition: At least one protocol file added to the selected protocols list.
Test Script (Step): Open the Parse tab and confirm both BurnIn Limits and Cal Limits path fields are empty.
Test Script (Expected Result): Both path fields are empty.

Test Script (Step): Add one or more _Protocol.txt files to the protocol list.
Test Script (Expected Result): Protocol files appear in the list.

Test Script (Step): Click Parse Data.
Test Script (Expected Result): Parsing runs. Status label shows 'Parsing finished. Protocols parsed: N.' No crash or error dialog.

Test Script (Step): Inspect the statistics table and accepted-protocols table after parsing.
Test Script (Expected Result): Accepted-protocols table is populated. Statistics table has rows but all limits columns are empty (no limit values loaded). Both group comboboxes remain disabled / empty.

Name: ST-08 Clear Data resets the parse table
Objective: Verify Clear Data removes all parsed data from the protocol table.
Precondition: ST-04 or ST-05 passed (at least one parse with loaded limits performed).
Test Script (Step): Confirm the accepted-protocols table is populated and group comboboxes are enabled.
Test Script (Expected Result): Accepted-protocols table shows parsed protocol rows. Group comboboxes are enabled.

Test Script (Step): Click Clear Data.
Test Script (Expected Result): clear_state() is called. Status label changes to 'No protocols loaded.' All numeric labels (parsed/loaded count) reset to 0.

Test Script (Step): Inspect the accepted-protocols table.
Test Script (Expected Result): Table is empty (all rows cleared to the default empty row set).

Test Script (Step): Inspect the BurnIn and Cal groups comboboxes.
Test Script (Expected Result): Both group comboboxes are empty and disabled.

Name: ST-09 Write Statistic populates the statistics table
Objective: Verify Write Statistic fills the stats table with limit-evaluation rows.
Precondition: ST-04 or ST-05 passed (parse completed with limits loaded).
Test Script (Step): Switch to the Statistics tab and confirm the statsTable is empty.
Test Script (Expected Result): Statistics tab is visible. statsTable has no rows.

Test Script (Step): Click Write Statistic.
Test Script (Expected Result): Application switches to the Statistics main tab (index 6). fill_stats_table() runs.

Test Script (Step): Inspect the statistics table.
Test Script (Expected Result): statsTable is populated with rows: each row corresponds to a limit entry (limitName column visible). Graph column shows 'Off'. No crash.

Name: ST-10 Forward navigation advances active group
Objective: Verify the Forward button increments the active group.
Precondition: ST-04 passed. At least two BurnIn groups exist.
Test Script (Step): Switch to the Statistics tab. Confirm the BurnIn radio button is selected. Note the current group name label.
Test Script (Expected Result): Group name label shows the name of the current active group (format: 'BurnIn: <name>').

Test Script (Step): Click the Forward (next group) navigation button.
Test Script (Expected Result): activeGroupIndex increments by 1. Group name label updates to 'BurnIn: <next group name>'. Statistics table updates for the new group.

Name: ST-11 Forward navigation wraps at the last group
Objective: Verify forward navigation wraps to the first group when at the end.
Precondition: ST-10 passes. Navigate forward until the last group is active.
Test Script (Step): Navigate forward until the group name label shows the last group.
Test Script (Expected Result): Group name label shows the last group name.

Test Script (Step): Click the Forward button once more.
Test Script (Expected Result): activeGroupIndex wraps to 0. Group name label updates to show the first group name ('BurnIn: <first group>').

Name: ST-12 Back navigation decrements active group
Objective: Verify the Back button decrements the active group.
Precondition: ST-10 passed. Currently on the second or later group.
Test Script (Step): Navigate forward to at least the second group. Confirm the group name label shows group index >= 1.
Test Script (Expected Result): Group name label shows the name of a non-first group.

Test Script (Step): Click the Back (previous group) navigation button.
Test Script (Expected Result): activeGroupIndex decrements by 1. Group name label updates to 'BurnIn: <previous group name>'. Statistics table updates.

Name: ST-13 Back navigation wraps at the first group
Objective: Verify back navigation wraps to the last group when at the first group.
Test Script (Step): Ensure the first group is active (group name label shows first group).
Test Script (Expected Result): Group name label shows the first group name.

Test Script (Step): Click the Back button once.
Test Script (Expected Result): activeGroupIndex wraps to len(limitsGroupList)-1. Group name label updates to the last group name.

Name: ST-14 Clear Selected Stats Data clears the statistics view
Objective: Verify Clear Sel. Stats Data resets the plot and graph selections without removing parsed protocols.
Precondition: ST-09 passed (stats table populated and at least one group activated with plotted data).
Test Script (Step): Activate a group to populate the plot. Confirm the plot frame shows data and the group name label shows 'BurnIn: <name>' or 'Calibration: <name>'.
Test Script (Expected Result): Plot frame shows at least one line/data point. Group name label is non-empty.

Test Script (Step): Click Clear Sel. Stats Data.
Test Script (Expected Result): Plot frame is cleared. All rows in statsTable have Graph column reset to 'Off' and Axis column reset to 'ax1'. Group name label resets to '' (empty string).

Test Script (Step): Switch to the Parse tab and inspect the accepted-protocols table.
Test Script (Expected Result): Accepted-protocols table is NOT affected and still contains the previously parsed protocol rows.

Name: ST-15 Group name label updates when a group is set active
Objective: Verify the group name label reflects the currently active group name and type.
Precondition: ST-04 passed. At least one group in the BurnIn combobox.
Test Script (Step): Switch to the Statistics tab. Confirm the BurnIn radio button is selected.
Test Script (Expected Result): BurnIn radio button is checked.

Test Script (Step): Activate a BurnIn group (via Write Statistic or forward navigation).
Test Script (Expected Result): set_limits_group_active() is called. Group name label reads 'BurnIn: <exact group name from BurnInLimGroups.yaml>'.

Test Script (Step): Switch to the Cal radio button and activate a Cal group.
Test Script (Expected Result): Group name label reads 'Calibration: <exact group name from CalLimGroups.yaml>'.
